messages.content: 今天的板球比賽中有誰？

function.name: sports_analyzer_get_schedule
function.description: Retrieve the schedule of cricket matches for a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date for which to get the schedule of matches.

sport.description: The type of sport. Default is cricket.

country.description: The country for which to get the schedule. If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "今天的板球比賽中有誰？" meaning "Who is playing in today's cricket matches?" We need to retrieve the schedule for today. Use the function sports_analyzer_get_schedule with date set to today's date. The user didn't specify sport or country; default sport is cricket, default country is USA. But we might want to include all countries? The function defaults to USA if not provided. The user didn't specify country. We can either use default or ask clarifying question. The user wants "who is playing in today's cricket matches". That implies we need to fetch schedule for today. Let's call the function with date= today's date. We need to format date as string. Probably "YYYY-MM-DD". Today is 2026-05-28. So date="2026-05-28". Sport default is cricket. Country default is USA. But maybe we want all countries? The function says default country is USA. If not provided, all countries will be included. Wait: "If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'". That seems contradictory. It says default is USA but if not provided, all countries will be included. Possibly a mistake. We can provide country="all" or omit. Let's omit country to get all. So call function with date="2026-05-28", sport="cricket". No country.
